title: Top 10 Essential Verbs in English for Absolute Beginners (A0–A1)
dek: Master the 10 most high-frequency verbs in English: be, have, think, know, like, want/would like, go/be going to, can, eat, and drink with rich phrases and sentence frames.

blocks.text: Welcome to Part 1 of our essential guide to high-frequency English verbs for absolute beginners (A0–A1)! Mastering these core verbs will unlock over 80% of daily spoken output. Each verb includes practical usages, collocations, sentence frames, and key grammar notes.

items:
**1. To Be (am / is / are):** Identity, states, age, and location.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'I am a student', 'He is at home', 'They are ready', 'I am 25 years old'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'be on time', 'be quiet', 'be right'.

**2. To Have (have / has):** Possession, relationships, and bodily states.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'I have a car', 'She has a sister', 'I have a headache'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'have breakfast', 'have a shower', 'have a good day'.

**3. To Think:** Expressing opinions, belief, and mental processing.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'I think so', 'What do you think about this?', 'I think it is a great idea'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'think twice', 'think about', 'think of'.

**4. To Know:** Factual knowledge, familiarity, and skills.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'I know the answer', 'Do you know him?', 'I know how to drive'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'let me know', 'as far as I know', 'you know'.

**5. To Like:** Expressing preferences and personal taste.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'I like coffee', 'She likes reading', 'Do you like sports?'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'like very much', 'would like', 'look like'.

**6. To Want / Would Like:** Desires, intentions, and polite requests.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'I want some water', 'I would like a cup of tea, please', 'Where do you want to go?'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'want to learn', 'would like to order', 'if you want'.

**7. To Go / Be Going To:** Movement, direction, and future intentions.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'I go to work by bus', 'She goes home', 'We are going to visit London next week'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'go home', 'go shopping', 'go on foot', 'be going to eat'.

**8. To Can (Modal):** Ability, possibility, and polite permission.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'I can speak English', 'Can you help me?', 'You can sit here'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'can I have...', 'as fast as I can', 'can do'.

**9. To Eat:** Meals, food consumption, and dining out.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'I eat fruit every morning', 'What do you want to eat?', 'Let's eat out tonight'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'eat healthy', 'eat out', 'something to eat'.

**10. To Drink:** Beverages, hydration, and social drinking.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'I drink water', 'Would you like something to drink?', 'He drinks coffee with milk'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'drink water', 'a hot drink', 'something to drink'.
